basic_info.description: Welcome to 1736-1738 Fell St, a rare opportunity to own three large Victorian flats, blending modern living with original architectural charm. This partially completed project offers significant upside potential, with framing, rough plumbing, and electrical already in place. Previously entitled, the property is now looking for a new investor or developer to bring it across the finish line, whether as a prime investment property or through a TIC/Condo conversion. The spacious upper flat features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and breathtaking views of Golden Gate Park’s Panhandle, along with a large unfinished attic that could be transformed into additional living space. The middle flat offers 3 bed, 2 baths, views of the Panhandle, and access to a small private yard. The lower flat, a 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit, provides ample space and privacy. Additional highlights include high ceilings, 3 private storage units w/side yard access, and separate meters for each unit.  Located just moments from Golden Gate Park, UCSF, the California Academy of Sciences, and the vibrant Haight-Ashbury neighborhood, this property offers easy access to some of SF's most iconic attractions. This is a unique chance to invest in a project with tremendous upside in one of the city’s most desirable locations
